title: porter port config
description: One port: what to port (dependency closure of seed classes), with which rules, into which target project, and how to compile, build and test it. Driven by `porter port --config <file>.port.yaml`. Strings may use ${NAME} variables (vars: or the environment). Relative paths resolve against the config file's directory, except sources, classpath.file and build.jar (project-relative). Every stage section is optional; a stage runs only when its section is present. Added by RFC 004; `inputs` and `prepare` added by RFC 007; plugins, setup, derive, patches, generate.langSections, install.assetNamespaces/langKeys by RFC 009 (all additive, schemaVersion stays 1).

name.description: Short id of the port (used in logs and reports).

mode.description: delta: the mod (or the host it extends) already exists on the target version; the port is an addon/delta over that base, and classes that are semantically identical in the base are left to it (closure.known is required). full: the mod does not exist on the target version and is ported whole; there is no base to keep (closure.known is not allowed).

vars.description: Variables for ${NAME} substitution (machine-specific paths belong here or in the environment).

project.description: Target mod project (a Gradle project, usually a git working tree).

sources.description: Java source root, relative to the project (default src/main/java).

work.description: Work directory: state, logs, intermediate outputs (default <project>/build/porter-port).

queue.description: Command prefix for heavy steps (child porter JVMs, javac, the build), e.g. a machine-wide job queue script.

jvmArgs.description: Default JVM options of child porter steps, e.g. [-Xmx2g].

inputs.description: The original files a player supplies (RFC 007, p5/ports): `porter run` verifies each file's sha256 and passes it as ${INPUT_<NAME>}. `porter port` itself ignores this section.

plugins.description: Jars added to child porter steps (PORTER_PLUGINS), e.g. a mod-specific extract pattern pack.

classpath.description: Target compile classpath: used by the compile stage, the loop (useClasspath) and as the type oracle of the hub stubs.

file.description: Project-relative file listing classpath entries (separated by ';' or newlines), e.g. written by a Gradle task.

exclude.description: Entries of the file that contain one of these substrings are dropped.

entries.description: More jars or class directories; globs (*, **, ?) allowed.

setup.description: Stage setup (first): one-time prerequisites; a step whose creates all exist is skipped.

derive.description: Stage derive (after setup): steps that derive the inputs of generate on every run (extract, select, assets, patches of the user's own sources).

inputs.description: The original files a player supplies (RFC 007): `porter run` verifies each file's sha256 before anything else and tells the player where to download a missing or wrong one. Values reach the config as ${INPUT_<NAME>} (the file) and, for kind sources, ${INPUT_<NAME>_DIR} (the unpacked tree); NAME is the input's name in upper case, '-' and '.' becoming '_'. `porter port` itself ignores this section.

mod.description: Name of the mod the file belongs to, as shown to the player.

version.description: Mod version the file is from.

kind.description: jar (default): a mod jar. sources: a .zip/.tar.gz/.tgz of a source tree (a single top-level directory is stripped).

page.description: Download page of the file (CurseForge, Modrinth, GitHub release...): where a player gets it. Never the file itself.

file.description: Exact file name on that page.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lower-case hex.

url.description: Direct download link; porter fetches the file itself when the player gave none. Only for files of open-licence mods; leave out for everything else.

optional.description: true: `porter run` works without this file (it is used only for extra checks); default false.

prepare.description: One-time `porter` command lines `porter run` executes before `porter port` (for example extract and assets); skipped when their stamp file shows they already ran. `porter port` ignores this section.

preserve.description: Project paths never overwritten by generated files (hand-edited generated files).

langSections.description: Merge each unit's generated .lang files into the project's under '# --- porter:<unit> ---' sections (in place; keys defined outside the section win) instead of keeping the project's file.

source.description: Source-version sources of the mod (e.g. a decompile).

prefixes.description: Package prefixes of the mod's own classes, e.g. [com.example.].

seeds.description: Top-level classes to port (what the AI or the user picked).

include.description: Classes copied in addition (walked like seeds).

cut.description: Hub prefixes: the walk stops; referenced hub classes become frontier stubs.

drop.description: Prefixes cut and not stubbed (references removed by rules or edits).

stubExtra.description: More classes to stub (e.g. types the stubs' signatures need).

known.description: delta mode: source roots of the base on the target side; closure classes whose API is identical there are not copied.

upfront.description: Optional stage before rewrite (RFC 011): `porter upfront` on the closure classes. Its emitted rules join the rewrite rule set, its generated shim sources are installed with the adapter pack, its TODO batch is written to <work>/upfront/batches.

jar.description: The mod jar built for the source version (bytecode is the first source of the symbol inventory).

data.description: Per version pair data directory holding the three above (default: rules/upfront/1.19.2__1.7.10 of the working directory).

emitRules.description: Add the emitted rules to the rewrite rule set (default true).

shimgen.description: Install the generated shim sources with the adapter pack (default true).

rules.description: Rule files/directories (public packs first, then private).

platform.description: Extra package prefixes whose symbols must be rewritten.

relocate.description: <from>=<to> package moves of the copied classes.

shimPackage.description: Package the shim and the adapter pack are relocated to.

overrides.description: Directory of hand-written hub classes (relocated paths) used instead of generated stubs.

keep.description: Hub members (source-version FQN `a.b.Hub#member`) copied as rewritten instead of stubbed: body/initializer given by rule declaration edits (RFC 010).

ownPrefix.description: Package prefix of the target mod's own classes (default: first segment of the relocation target).

unportedPrefixes.description: Relocated packages that were not ported (types there are invalid in stubs); default: relocated top-level packages of the closure.

header.description: First line(s) of every generated stub.

srgMappings.description: tiny v2 file with mojmap and srg namespaces of the source version (from the user's own mapping download; never shipped).

edits.description: YAML list of counted call-site edits {file, pattern, replace, reason} (Python-style regex, DOTALL, first match).

adapters.description: bundled: copy porter's generic adapter pack, relocated to rewrite.shimPackage.

overlays.description: Directories copied over the stage in order (hand-written classes, mod-specific adapters).

assetNamespaces.description: Pass assetns: new ResourceLocation(from, "<path>...") with one of the path prefixes gets namespace to.

langKeys.description: After install: lang keys that the project's sources look up literally (pattern group 1), copied from the source mod's JSON lang files into a marked section of the existing target .lang files.

scan.description: Project-relative source dir to scan (default src/main/java).

useClasspath.description: Pass the project sources, generated sources and the classpath (javac runner).

javaHome.description: JDK whose javac is used (default: the JDK running porter).

generatedSources.description: Small sources the project's build normally generates (e.g. a version Tags class).

command.description: Run in the project directory, e.g. [./gradlew, --no-daemon, spotlessApply, build].

jar.description: Project-relative path of the built (reobfuscated) jar.

obfcheckPrefix.description: Internal-name prefix of the classes the reobf collision check covers, e.g. mymod/.

args.description: A porter command line, e.g. [test, diff, --scenario, ...].

queue.description: Command prefix for this run (e.g. a single-Minecraft-instance lock).

patches.description: Unified diffs applied after a stage (porter patch apply): '---' paths relative to base (default: target), '+++' paths relative to target (default: the project).
A patch file or a directory of *.patch files.

creates.description: Paths the step creates; when all exist the step is skipped (one-time setup).

command.description: An external command; ./gradlew runs gradlew.bat on Windows.

queue.description: Run behind the config's queue prefix (default true).

composite.description: An image: base with the overlay's non-transparent pixels.
